method.rule: Our price is 10% below the benchmark, rounded to the nearest 10 cents.
method.benchmark: The lowest credible like-for-like Australian retail price for the same pack size, GST inclusive. Lowest rather than median, because that is the number a customer comparing actually finds, and undercutting the cheapest is the positioning the site already claims in print.
method.gst: Every benchmark is normalised to GST inclusive before the 10% comes off. This matters more than it looks. Livingstone and the other trade suppliers quote ex GST, Chemist Warehouse and Amazon quote inc GST, and an Australian site showing a consumer price has to show it GST inclusive. Taking 10% off an ex GST trade price would have put us about 1% ABOVE that supplier once GST was added, which is the opposite of the instruction.
method.excluded: Grey import and overseas listings, because 10% under a parallel import is not a price this business can hold. US, UK, India, Singapore and NZ results were discarded wherever they appeared.
method.pack_sizes: Compared per pack, never per unit. A box of 100 and a box of 200 are different products to a buyer.
method.larger_packs: Where only the base pack has a findable comparable, the larger packs keep the bulk discount curve the catalogue already had, applied to the new base price, so the per unit saving stays coherent instead of being invented twice.

limitation: Every benchmark here comes from web search results, not from a live product page. This session cannot reach retail hosts directly: a fetch of www.livingstone.com.au and www.medshop.com.au both failed to resolve, so the figures are search snapshots and several carried a January 2025 date. They are good enough to set a provisional price and not good enough to defend to the cent. To verify against live pages, the environment network policy needs those hosts allowed.

coverage.why_left_alone: No credible like for like Australian comparable was found, so the existing figure stands rather than being replaced by a second invented one. Each has its reason recorded below.
